test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

If __it will rain tomorrow__, I will be on leave.
solution:
The correct answer is **'It rains tomorrow'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, the conditional clause **"If it will rain tomorrow"** is expressing a condition that might or might not happen in the future. 
 
• The main clause states the consequence of that condition.
